lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of approximately four to five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots located on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the central flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with light intensity on the dorsal side and shadowing on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible anterior portion of the first dorsal fin displays a dense cluster of small, irregularly shaped high-luminance blobs that are significantly smaller than the primary flank spots.

other_distinctive_markers: Five distinct vertical gill slits are visible; a sharp transition is present between high-density micro-spots on the cephalic region and larger maculations on the trunk.
